text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Oooooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I did it...! Even in a GⅠ, I gave it my 
all!! The absolute best race I'm capable 
of right now!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm not done yet...! More, even more! I 
can reach even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My "dream"... is gonna burn hotter and 
hotter!!

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo Memory is amazing. She's even more 
energetic after finishing her run...

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I can't let myself fall behind. I need 
to face forward, just like that girl...!

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
In the next race, even I'm gonna... just 
like Bamboo-san did... bring out even more 
of my power...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa. Even without Oguri, that was crazy 
intense... I'd better remember the name 
Bamboo Memory...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo Memory really is the rising star 
of the sprint division! Looks like this 
year's Sprinters Stakes is gonna be 
thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Her bold running style is so exciting~ I 
can't wait to see what lies ahead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
On the turf, and in the stands as well... 
A distinctly new passion is beginning to 
brew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And that was true for me as well—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—So this is who you really are, 
Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“—After running in today's race, I've 
really gained a whole new wave of 
confidence...!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Aim even higher...! You're saying I can 
reach the pinnacle of sprint racing...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps achieving results helped her 
break through a wall—even after finishing 
the race, Bamboo Memory was brimming with 
boundless vitality...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Bamboo. That was truly a 
magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-senpai!! Thank you so much for 
coming to watch today!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No. If anything, I'm the one who should be 
thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
“—There are things we can only express 
through our running, not through words.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san. Your earnestness. Your 
resolve. Your "dream." I witnessed them 
all clearly in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Emulating the unyielding brilliance you 
showed me, I, too, shall march forward— 
toward my very own "dream."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ardan-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I really wanted to tell you this in 
person, so I came by. Well then, I shall 
take my leave now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san. I shall be quietly cheering on 
your "dream" from now on as well. Until 
next time—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
choice_data_list: I'm glad your "dream" got through to them.
I'm glad your "dream" got through to them.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!! My passion reached 
Ardan-senpai, came right back around, and 
got me all fired up again too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer! What race should I take on next?!
choice_data_list:
Next, let's test our strength in a Mile 
G1!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A mile! Which means—
choice_data_list: We're aiming for the Yasuda Kinen!
Let's aim for the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!!! The race to decide the 
first-half Mile Champion!!! I'm gettin' 
all fired uuup!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna get even better 
results at the Yasuda Kinen than today!! 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become the greatest Umamusume 
ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, fueled by tangible results, the 
next challenge— the Yasuda Kinen—was 
underway...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days after the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Mhm, mhm! The stands are looking spotless 
today too! And with that, today's patrol 
is complete...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Chiyonoo...! That's right, now that your 
return has been decided, your training is 
already back in full swing...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll get to see Chiyono O race again 
soon...! Along with Ardan-senpai and 
Yaeno...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, Chiyono O...! 'Cause I'm 
really looking forward to seeing you run 
again...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I shouldn't disturb them. Maybe I'll 
hit the gym after this, too...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I... as I thought, it's just...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A faint sigh escaped Sakura Chiyono O's 
lips. Bamboo Memory, forging ahead toward 
the Yasuda Kinen, had no way of knowing 
this...
